content.name: Roisin Halloran
profile: Registered general nurse with six years' experience in acute medical and emergency settings, currently working as a clinical nurse manager on a thirty-bed medical ward. Looking for a management post closer to home in the mid-west.

experience.title: Clinical Nurse Manager 1
bullets: Day-to-day management of a thirty-bed acute medical ward with a team of twenty-four nursing and healthcare assistant staff.
Produced the six-week roster and covered gaps through the agency and the internal bank.
Led a falls-prevention audit that reduced inpatient falls on the ward by a third in twelve months.
Preceptor and assessor for third- and fourth-year student nurses on placement.

experience.title: Staff Nurse, Emergency Department
bullets: Triage, resuscitation bay and majors in a department seeing over two hundred patients a day.
Completed the postgraduate emergency diploma while working full-time shifts.

experience.title: Staff Nurse, Medical Ward
bullets: First post after registration on a twenty-bed elective medical ward.
Completed the clinic's medication management and IV competencies within three months.

certifications: Registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (RGN)
